abominably.oewn-00311025-r.label: negative
abominably.oewn-00311025-r.tone: The adverb of *abominable*: moral revulsion - condemns rather than criticises.

acceptably.oewn-00055850-r.label: neutral
acceptably.oewn-00055850-r.tone: The adverb of *acceptable*: clears the bar and no more; in speech it often signals mild disappointment.

affably.oewn-00221532-r.label: positive
affably.oewn-00221532-r.tone: The adverb of *affable*: praises ease of manner in someone who need not have bothered - it fits people with standing.

amiably.oewn-00221532-r.label: positive
amiably.oewn-00221532-r.tone: The adverb of *amiable*: mild, slightly old-fashioned praise; pleasantness rather than depth.

angrily.oewn-00228939-r.label: negative
angrily.oewn-00228939-r.tone: The adverb of *angry*: reports the feeling without judging it; the mildest and least loaded word in the family.

aptly.oewn-00186658-r.label: positive
aptly.oewn-00186658-r.tone: The adverb of *apt*: quick to learn - formal and slightly old-fashioned.

arrogantly.oewn-00267447-r.label: negative
arrogantly.oewn-00267447-r.tone: The adverb of *arrogant*: condemns self-importance as unearned - the confidence is real, the entitlement is not.

atrociously.oewn-00055639-r.label: negative
atrociously.oewn-00055639-r.tone: The adverb of *atrocious*: severe and formal - originally of cruelty, now also of quality.

awfully.oewn-00055488-r.label: negative
awfully.oewn-00055488-r.tone: The adverb of *awful*: strong condemnation, common enough to have lost some of its force.

badly.oewn-00016415-r.label: negative
badly.oewn-00016415-r.tone: The adverb of *bad*: the plain word of disapproval - broad and unemphatic.

beautifully.oewn-00243465-r.label: positive
beautifully.oewn-00243465-r.tone: The adverb of *beautiful*: the full word - unreserved and applicable to anything from a face to an argument.

benevolently.oewn-00396497-r.label: positive
benevolently.oewn-00396497-r.tone: The adverb of *benevolent*: praises the disposition rather than any particular gift; often said of institutions.

boastfully.oewn-00227289-r.label: negative
boastfully.oewn-00227289-r.tone: The adverb of *boastful*: faults the telling rather than the feeling - pride said out loud too often.

bonnily.oewn-00501131-r.label: positive
bonnily.oewn-00501131-r.tone: The adverb of *bonny*: scottish and northern English warmth - healthy and pleasing.

bounteously.oewn-00281297-r.label: positive
bounteously.oewn-00281297-r.tone: The adverb of *bounteous*: biblical in flavour, and hard to use now without irony.

bountifully.oewn-00281297-r.label: positive
bountifully.oewn-00281297-r.tone: The adverb of *bountiful*: usually of harvests and nature rather than people; abundance more than kindness.

bravely.oewn-00174412-r.label: positive
bravely.oewn-00174412-r.tone: The adverb of *brave*: the plain, universal praise - facing what frightens you.

brightly.oewn-00077434-r.label: positive
brightly.oewn-00077434-r.tone: The adverb of *bright*: warm and everyday - quick to learn, most often said of the young.

brilliantly.oewn-00077434-r.label: positive
brilliantly.oewn-00077434-r.tone: The adverb of *brilliant*: exceptional intelligence - the strongest ordinary compliment.

buxomly.oewn-00239005-r.label: positive
buxomly.oewn-00239005-r.tone: The adverb of *buxom*: old-fashioned approval of a full, healthy female figure - dated, and only used of women.

cantankerously.oewn-00282813-r.label: negative
cantankerously.oewn-00282813-r.tone: The adverb of *cantankerous*: almost fond, in the way one is fond of a difficult relative; the word is too comic to wound.

carelessly.oewn-00165349-r.label: negative
carelessly.oewn-00165349-r.tone: The adverb of *careless*: the plain accusation: attention was owed and not paid.

casually.oewn-00265324-r.label: negative
casually.oewn-00265324-r.tone: The adverb of *casual*: often neutral or even approving elsewhere; here it means attention that was never offered.

cleverly.oewn-00188967-r.label: positive
cleverly.oewn-00188967-r.tone: The adverb of *clever*: praises ingenuity - though 'too clever' turns it into a fault.

comfortably.oewn-00156018-r.label: positive
comfortably.oewn-00156018-r.tone: The adverb of *comfortable*: the modest way to say it - enough money, and no wish to discuss it.

conceitedly.oewn-00290736-r.label: negative
conceitedly.oewn-00290736-r.tone: The adverb of *conceited*: faults an inflated opinion of one's own qualities.

cordially.oewn-00221335-r.label: positive
cordially.oewn-00221335-r.tone: The adverb of *cordial*: warm in form rather than in feeling - a cordial greeting can be perfectly correct and quite cold.

courageously.oewn-00174412-r.label: positive
courageously.oewn-00174412-r.tone: The adverb of *courageous*: weightier than 'brave' - implies moral choice, not just nerve.

courteously.oewn-00219959-r.label: positive
courteously.oewn-00219959-r.tone: The adverb of *courteous*: formal warmth, with a whiff of chivalry - it praises the manner as a kind of respect.

cozily.oewn-00188632-r.label: positive
cozily.oewn-00188632-r.tone: The adverb of *cozy*: of an atmosphere rather than a person - and it turns critical the moment it takes an object: cozy with the regulators.

cursorily.oewn-00292249-r.label: negative
cursorily.oewn-00292249-r.tone: The adverb of *cursory*: formal and cool - it reports the shallowness without raising its voice.

dandily.oewn-00505761-r.label: positive
dandily.oewn-00505761-r.tone: The adverb of *dandy*: old-fashioned cheer - now often used ironically.

deadly.oewn-00306284-r.label: negative
deadly.oewn-00306284-r.tone: The adverb of *dead*: the plain word. Direct and unsoftened; every other word in this family exists to avoid it.

deceitfully.oewn-00315990-r.label: negative
deceitfully.oewn-00315990-r.tone: The adverb of *deceitful*: puts the intent in view: not merely wrong, but meaning to mislead.

decently.oewn-00248673-r.label: positive
decently.oewn-00248673-r.tone: The adverb of *decent*: warm but modest - better than expected without being remarkable.

deceptively.oewn-00082498-r.label: negative
deceptively.oewn-00082498-r.tone: The adverb of *deceptive*: mild because it does not require a liar - a shadow or a photograph can be deceptive.

densely.oewn-00324708-r.label: negative
densely.oewn-00324708-r.tone: The adverb of *dense*: mild and often jokey - failing to grasp what is plain.

deplorably.oewn-00093820-r.label: negative
deplorably.oewn-00093820-r.tone: The adverb of *deplorable*: formal censure, expecting the reader to share the judgement.

dimly.oewn-00213113-r.label: negative
dimly.oewn-00213113-r.tone: The adverb of *dim*: gently disparaging, common in British use.

dishonestly.oewn-00315990-r.label: negative
dishonestly.oewn-00315990-r.tone: The adverb of *dishonest*: the plain word for it, and still an accusation - it names a settled disposition to cheat, not one bad day.

dishonorably.oewn-00493222-r.label: negative
dishonorably.oewn-00493222-r.tone: The adverb of *dishonorable*: judges the breach of a code rather than the lie itself; what is lost is standing, not just truth.

doggedly.oewn-00237428-r.label: positive
doggedly.oewn-00237428-r.tone: The adverb of *dogged*: the same refusal to yield, entirely admired - dogged is what stubborn is called when it wins.

dourly.oewn-00243780-r.label: negative
dourly.oewn-00243780-r.tone: The adverb of *dour*: unyielding and unsmiling; it judges the manner as much as the will.

dreadfully.oewn-00056878-r.label: negative
dreadfully.oewn-00056878-r.tone: The adverb of *dreadful*: emphatic disapproval with a formal, slightly literary edge.

dumbly.oewn-00324708-r.label: negative
dumbly.oewn-00324708-r.tone: The adverb of *dumb*: harsh and casual; also an older, now offensive word for mute.

excellently.oewn-00183802-r.label: positive
excellently.oewn-00183802-r.tone: The adverb of *excellent*: unqualified praise - at the top of its class.

exquisitely.oewn-00103013-r.label: positive
exquisitely.oewn-00103013-r.tone: The adverb of *exquisite*: beauty of fine detail - praise for delicacy and craft.

falsely.oewn-00338017-r.label: negative
falsely.oewn-00338017-r.tone: The adverb of *false*: said of things rather than people - a false name, a false wall; the object was built to deceive.

fatuously.oewn-00203322-r.label: negative
fatuously.oewn-00203322-r.tone: The adverb of *fatuous*: silliness with self-satisfaction attached.

fearfully.oewn-00200994-r.label: negative
fearfully.oewn-00200994-r.tone: The adverb of *fearful*: names the fear without judging the person for it.

foolishly.oewn-00203162-r.label: negative
foolishly.oewn-00203162-r.tone: The adverb of *foolish*: faults the judgement rather than the intelligence - a wise person can act foolishly.

fraudulently.oewn-00346945-r.label: negative
fraudulently.oewn-00346945-r.tone: The adverb of *fraudulent*: the legal word: it implies a crime has been committed, not merely a lie told.

furiously.oewn-00225764-r.label: negative
furiously.oewn-00225764-r.tone: The adverb of *furious*: the everyday word for full anger - vivid, and still sympathetic to whoever feels it.

gallantly.oewn-00285918-r.label: positive
gallantly.oewn-00285918-r.tone: The adverb of *gallant*: chivalrous courage - noble and old-fashioned.

gamely.oewn-00348618-r.label: positive
gamely.oewn-00348618-r.tone: The adverb of *game*: willing to try - courage as good sportsmanship rather than heroism.

generously.oewn-00198104-r.label: positive
generously.oewn-00198104-r.tone: The adverb of *generous*: the plain, unqualified praise - it credits both the giving and the spirit behind it.

genially.oewn-00221532-r.label: positive
genially.oewn-00221532-r.tone: The adverb of *genial*: warmth that puts a room at ease; usually said of hosts.

genteelly.oewn-00349398-r.label: positive
genteelly.oewn-00349398-r.tone: The adverb of *genteel*: faintly pitying since the nineteenth century - shabby-genteel is never far away.

genuinely.oewn-00037620-r.label: positive
genuinely.oewn-00037620-r.tone: The adverb of *genuine*: warm without being showy: it says a thing is what it claims, and that this was worth saying.

gorgeously.oewn-00351959-r.label: positive
gorgeously.oewn-00351959-r.tone: The adverb of *gorgeous*: dazzling and enthusiastic - beauty that stops you.

graciously.oewn-00195866-r.label: positive
graciously.oewn-00195866-r.tone: The adverb of *gracious*: the warmest here: courtesy extended when it need not have been, usually downwards.

greatly.oewn-00057077-r.label: positive
greatly.oewn-00057077-r.tone: The adverb of *great*: everyday enthusiasm - the common word for real approval.

grotesquely.oewn-00353338-r.label: negative
grotesquely.oewn-00353338-r.tone: The adverb of *grotesque*: distorted to the point of unsettling - beyond plain ugliness.

haggardly.oewn-00505079-r.label: negative
haggardly.oewn-00505079-r.tone: The adverb of *haggard*: thin and worn out - exhaustion showing in the face.

handsomely.oewn-00354848-r.label: positive
handsomely.oewn-00354848-r.tone: The adverb of *handsome*: praises strong, well-proportioned looks; used of men, and of women to suggest dignity over prettiness.

haphazardly.oewn-00071165-r.label: negative
haphazardly.oewn-00071165-r.tone: The adverb of *haphazard*: blames the absence of a method rather than the absence of effort.

haughtily.oewn-00176109-r.label: negative
haughtily.oewn-00176109-r.tone: The adverb of *haughty*: cold, distant superiority - looking down from a height.

heedlessly.oewn-00165349-r.label: negative
heedlessly.oewn-00165349-r.tone: The adverb of *heedless*: warnings existed and were ignored; it presumes there was something to heed.

hideously.oewn-00358561-r.label: negative
hideously.oewn-00358561-r.tone: The adverb of *hideous*: extreme and repellent - among the harshest words available.

honestly.oewn-00316228-r.label: positive
honestly.oewn-00316228-r.tone: The adverb of *honest*: of a thing rather than a person - honest money, honest weight; it lends objects a moral character.

inanely.oewn-00203322-r.label: negative
inanely.oewn-00203322-r.tone: The adverb of *inane*: empty of sense - condemns the content, not the person.

indolently.oewn-00374926-r.label: negative
indolently.oewn-00374926-r.tone: The adverb of *indolent*: the softest of the real accusations - it sounds almost like a temperament.

intelligently.oewn-00203457-r.label: positive
intelligently.oewn-00203457-r.tone: The adverb of *intelligent*: the neutral, respectable word - approving without flourish.

lackadaisically.oewn-00387445-r.label: negative
lackadaisically.oewn-00387445-r.tone: The adverb of *lackadaisical*: comic rather than damning; the failing is a lack of spirit, not of will.

lately.oewn-00108184-r.label: positive
lately.oewn-00108184-r.tone: The adverb of *late*: respectful and gentle - names the death while keeping the person in view.

lazily.oewn-00389429-r.label: negative
lazily.oewn-00389429-r.tone: The adverb of *lazy*: the everyday charge, and a moral one: the work was there and was not done.

liberally.oewn-00198286-r.label: positive
liberally.oewn-00198286-r.tone: The adverb of *liberal*: of portions and allowances, not politics - though the political sense now shadows every use.

lifelessly.oewn-00391203-r.label: negative
lifelessly.oewn-00391203-r.tone: The adverb of *lifeless*: clinical and detached - describes a body, not a person.

mincingly.oewn-00404188-r.label: negative
mincingly.oewn-00404188-r.tone: The adverb of *mincing*: mocks refinement as performance - the word describes the walk, and means the person.

misleadingly.oewn-00082498-r.label: negative
misleadingly.oewn-00082498-r.tone: The adverb of *misleading*: stops short of accusation: it reports the effect, and leaves the intent unstated.

monstrously.oewn-00358561-r.label: negative
monstrously.oewn-00358561-r.tone: The adverb of *monstrous*: ugliness that frightens; also used of moral wrong.

naughtily.oewn-00017140-r.label: negative
naughtily.oewn-00017140-r.tone: The adverb of *naughty*: affectionate scolding, mostly of children - too light for real fault.

nicely.oewn-00188540-r.label: positive
nicely.oewn-00188540-r.tone: The adverb of *nice*: weak from overuse; it now praises so mildly that it can read as faint disappointment.

obstinately.oewn-00200274-r.label: negative
obstinately.oewn-00200274-r.tone: The adverb of *obstinate*: colder and more formal than stubborn; it withholds the affection stubborn allows.

obtusely.oewn-00324708-r.label: negative
obtusely.oewn-00324708-r.tone: The adverb of *obtuse*: formal reproach - slow to understand, and perhaps unwilling to.

overbearingly.oewn-00417692-r.label: negative
overbearingly.oewn-00417692-r.tone: The adverb of *overbearing*: superiority that pushes other people around.

perfunctorily.oewn-00261760-r.label: negative
perfunctorily.oewn-00261760-r.tone: The adverb of *perfunctory*: the work was done to be seen to be done; it accuses the motive, not the skill.

plainly.oewn-00039730-r.label: negative
plainly.oewn-00039730-r.tone: The adverb of *plain*: polite avoidance - unremarkable rather than unattractive.

politely.oewn-00219959-r.label: positive
politely.oewn-00219959-r.tone: The adverb of *polite*: the plain positive of the group: it describes conduct anyone can manage, and asks for no admiration.

poorly.oewn-00011978-r.label: negative
poorly.oewn-00011978-r.tone: The adverb of *poor*: the plain word for a lasting condition - factual, but heavy enough that officials avoid it.

prettily.oewn-00433289-r.label: positive
prettily.oewn-00433289-r.tone: The adverb of *pretty*: pleasing but slight - delicate rather than striking, and faintly diminishing when used of adults.

primly.oewn-00433542-r.label: negative
primly.oewn-00433542-r.tone: The adverb of *prim*: disapproves gently: correct manners held so tightly they have become a fault.

prosperously.oewn-00016322-r.label: positive
prosperously.oewn-00016322-r.tone: The adverb of *prosperous*: wealth read as the reward of success - approving.

proudly.oewn-00191358-r.label: neutral
proudly.oewn-00191358-r.tone: The adverb of *proud*: genuinely two-faced: proud of your children is warm, proud to a fault is a failing. Context decides.

pusillanimously.oewn-00457002-r.label: negative
pusillanimously.oewn-00457002-r.tone: The adverb of *pusillanimous*: bookish contempt - small-spirited in the face of difficulty.

quickly.oewn-00086161-r.label: positive
quickly.oewn-00086161-r.tone: The adverb of *quick*: praises speed of understanding rather than depth.

ravishingly.oewn-00441443-r.label: positive
ravishingly.oewn-00441443-r.tone: The adverb of *ravishing*: overwhelming beauty - lush and a little theatrical.

recklessly.oewn-00356657-r.label: negative
recklessly.oewn-00356657-r.tone: The adverb of *reckless*: the gravest here - it implies danger, and appears in law for that reason.

repulsively.oewn-00311025-r.label: negative
repulsively.oewn-00311025-r.tone: The adverb of *repulsive*: ugliness that actively drives people away.

richly.oewn-00398920-r.label: positive
richly.oewn-00398920-r.tone: The adverb of *rich*: the plain word - direct, and sometimes faintly accusing depending on who says it.

rottenly.oewn-00055639-r.label: negative
rottenly.oewn-00055639-r.tone: The adverb of *rotten*: thoroughly bad, with a hint of moral distaste.

satisfactorily.oewn-00015830-r.label: neutral
satisfactorily.oewn-00015830-r.tone: The adverb of *satisfactory*: meets the requirement - the language of reports and inspections, not of praise.

savagely.oewn-00202624-r.label: negative
savagely.oewn-00202624-r.tone: The adverb of *savage*: the metaphor is an animal attack - it says the criticism went past its target.

slenderly.oewn-00460568-r.label: positive
slenderly.oewn-00460568-r.tone: The adverb of *slender*: admiring - thinness with grace built into the word.

slightly.oewn-00036695-r.label: positive
slightly.oewn-00036695-r.tone: The adverb of *slight*: delicately built - descriptive and mild, with no sting.

slimly.oewn-00460568-r.label: positive
slimly.oewn-00460568-r.tone: The adverb of *slim*: the polite compliment - thin in a way people want to be.

sloppily.oewn-00460908-r.label: negative
sloppily.oewn-00460908-r.tone: The adverb of *sloppy*: the everyday version, mild enough to say to someone's face.

slowly.oewn-00162829-r.label: negative
slowly.oewn-00162829-r.tone: The adverb of *slow*: the softened word - avoids naming a deficit outright.

smartly.oewn-00188967-r.label: positive
smartly.oewn-00188967-r.tone: The adverb of *smart*: common approval of quickness; in some uses it edges toward cunning.

solidly.oewn-00233065-r.label: positive
solidly.oewn-00233065-r.tone: The adverb of *solid*: praises dependability rather than brilliance - built to last.

stubbornly.oewn-00200274-r.label: negative
stubbornly.oewn-00200274-r.tone: The adverb of *stubborn*: mildly critical, and often affectionate - it can be said of a child or a stain.

stunningly.oewn-00211285-r.label: positive
stunningly.oewn-00211285-r.tone: The adverb of *stunning*: striking enough to arrest attention.

stupidly.oewn-00176830-r.label: negative
stupidly.oewn-00176830-r.tone: The adverb of *stupid*: the blunt, wounding word - a flat verdict on someone's mind.

superbly.oewn-00184576-r.label: positive
superbly.oewn-00184576-r.tone: The adverb of *superb*: surpassing praise, with a note of polish and craft.

superciliously.oewn-00462203-r.label: negative
superciliously.oewn-00462203-r.tone: The adverb of *supercilious*: formal contempt - superiority worn openly, with a raised eyebrow.

superficially.oewn-00144756-r.label: negative
superficially.oewn-00144756-r.tone: The adverb of *superficial*: cuts twice - shallow work, and often a shallow person implied behind it.

terribly.oewn-00055488-r.label: negative
terribly.oewn-00055488-r.tone: The adverb of *terrible*: blunt and total - among the strongest everyday condemnations.

thinly.oewn-00480070-r.label: neutral
thinly.oewn-00480070-r.tone: The adverb of *thin*: the plain, unloaded word - it states the shape and passes no judgement.

timidly.oewn-00230526-r.label: negative
timidly.oewn-00230526-r.tone: The adverb of *timid*: gentle - shyness rather than failure of nerve, and rarely an accusation.

trenchantly.oewn-00483185-r.label: positive
trenchantly.oewn-00483185-r.tone: The adverb of *trenchant*: sharp and penetrating - praise for incisive thought.

trimly.oewn-00466658-r.label: positive
trimly.oewn-00466658-r.tone: The adverb of *trim*: neat and in good shape - credits effort.

unquestionably.oewn-00439469-r.label: positive
unquestionably.oewn-00439469-r.tone: The adverb of *unquestionable*: praises by refusing to entertain doubt - it closes the argument rather than winning it.

vainly.oewn-00168943-r.label: negative
vainly.oewn-00168943-r.tone: The adverb of *vain*: excessive pride in appearance or achievement - shallow rather than dangerous.

valiantly.oewn-00494093-r.label: positive
valiantly.oewn-00494093-r.tone: The adverb of *valiant*: heroic register, at home in battle and legend.

wealthily.oewn-00496653-r.label: positive
wealthily.oewn-00496653-r.tone: The adverb of *wealthy*: substantial and settled money - more dignified than 'rich'.
